task_title: docs(SCHEDULER-ADMISSION) + sibling artifact: one query prints ratio and arm flag; documented census reports the disabled row
task_criteria: At commit 2da1014: docs/SCHEDULER-ADMISSION.md no longer claims the family is fully enabled (grep for that assertion returns 0 matches), states the measured 17 ceiling-bearing rows / 16 enabled with code-factory-qa enabled=0 via auto-disable, and carries ONE sqlite query that prints each row's ratio beside its enabled flag. docs/audits/code-factory-docs-2026-11-04-cf169-validator-claim.md no longer states that all rows are enabled=1 and attributes the correction to CF-176. docs/audits/code-factory-docs-2026-11-04-CF-176.md quotes both queries' literal output, the SELFTEST: PASS runs at the base and at both implementation commits, and RESULT: OK from scripts/boardctl validate.

(c) SCHEDULER-ADMISSION.md:59-63 is the only `sqlite3` in the file (`grep -c sqlite3` = 1): `select name, case when cooldown_floor_s>0 then cooldown_ceiling_s/cooldown_floor_s end ratio, enabled, coalesce(disabled_by,'-') disabled_by from projects where name like '<family>%' and cooldown_ceiling_s>0;` — ratio and enabled in one output. (d) cf169-validator-claim.md:89-93 now reads 'At that same measurement 16 of those 17 rows were `enabled=1`: `code-factory-qa` was already `enabled=0` (`disabled_by=auto-disable`, failure rate 91.3%)' and 'that sentence was wrong and is **superseded by CF-176** (`docs/audits/code-factory-docs-2026-11-04-CF-176.md`)'; the old 'Every one of those rows is enabled=1' no longer appears in that file (only quoted as the before-state at CF-176.md:129). (e) CF-176.md §3 lines 68-88 quote the census query with its literal 17-row table (code-factory-qa 8x, enabled=0, auto-disable) plus the `... and enabled=0` query output `code-factory-qa|0|auto-disable|failure rate 91.3% (84/92 ticks, window 100, threshold 0.90)`, and lines 96-123 quote the prescribed one-query output with ratio+enabled columns. (f) CF-176.md §4 lines 143-147: `1fea92d` (base) SELFTEST: PASS exit 0, `9149ff8` (first impl) SELFTEST: PASS exit 0, this commit SELFTEST: PASS exit 0; independently re-ran `bash tests/selftest.sh` at 2da1014 -> 'SELFTEST: PASS', exit_code 0. (g) CF-176.md:149 '`bash scripts/boardctl validate` at this commit: `RESULT: OK (3 warning(s))`'; independently re-ran -> 'RESULT: OK (3 warning(s))', exit_code 0. Minor caveat (not criterion-breaking): the §3 transcript's broader claim `grep -rc 'every row enabled' docs/*.md ... -> NO_MATCHES_ANY_DOC` is stale at this commit because CF-176.md itself now contains the phrase; the criterion's actual target (SCHEDULER-ADMISSION.md) does return 0 matches.
All legs of the single criterion hold at 2da1014: the false family-wide claim is gone from SCHEDULER-ADMISSION.md (0 grep matches), the 17/16 census with code-factory-qa enabled=0 via auto-disable is stated, exactly one sqlite query prints ratio beside enabled, the cf169 sibling artifact is corrected and attributed to CF-176, and CF-176.md quotes both queries' literal output plus SELFTEST: PASS at base and both implementation commits and RESULT: OK from boardctl validate (both gates independently re-run green).
